Ed Sheeran has officially announced he’s now an independent artist after leaving Warner Music following a 15-year run with the label. Sheeran revealed he quietly exited the company a month ago as he looks toward “a new way of working” outside the traditional major label system.

🗞️ | Harry Styles Thanks Niall, Louis, Zayn and Liam During Emotional Wembley Finale Harry Styles closed his record-breaking Wembley Stadium residency with an emotional tribute to his former One Direction bandmates, taking a moment on the final night of his London run to thank the people who helped shape his career. Addressing the sold-out crowd on Friday, July 4, Styles reflected on the journey that brought him to one of the biggest milestones of his solo career before mentioning each of his former bandmates by name, including the late Liam Payne. The speech capped an extraordinary 12-night residency at Wembley Stadium as part of the Together, Together Tour, which supports his fourth studio album, Kiss All the Time. Disco, Occasionally. , released in March 2026. The residency officially surpassed Coldplay’s previous record of 10 Wembley shows in a single year, making Styles the artist with the most performances at the venue in a single calendar year.

The estate of Prince has reportedly announced a new posthumous album titled “Timeless,” set for release on August 28. 🎶 💜 The project is expected to feature previously unreleased material from the artist’s extensive vault—something fans have long known exists in large quantities following his passing in 2016. Since then, several posthumous releases and archival projects have offered a glimpse into the depth of his unreleased work, continuing to expand his already legendary catalog. While details about Timeless remain limited, the announcement has already sparked excitement, as any new release carries the weight of Prince’s legacy and his reputation for pushing musical boundaries. Even years later, his influence—and his music—continue to evolve. ✨ ~ @spotify
